description: Time-aware "what statutory filing is due next?" Returns upcoming filings sorted soonest-first, each with a computed `nextDue` date and `daysUntil`. Optional `country`, `withinDays` (e.g. the next 30/60/90 days), `limit`, and `asOf` (reference date, defaults to today UTC). A concrete date is computed only when it can be placed unambiguously (monthly filings with a due day, or entries with explicit annual dates); quarterly/half-yearly entries given only a day-of-month and per-event filings come back with `scheduleVaries: true` and `nextDue: null`. Dates rotate annually — confirm against each `source` URL.

asOf.description: Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) to compute "next" from. Defaults to today (UTC).

country.description: Restrict to one country (ISO-2). Omit for every country.

withinDays.description: Only return filings whose next due date falls within this many days.

name: next_deadlines
